Write {"file_path":"D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\bdd\features\core\loyalty.feature","content":"Feature: Loyalty Management

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getLoyaltyPoints is called, the client shall return LP balances per corporation
    Given an authenticated character with LP from multiple corporations
    When the client calls getLoyaltyPoints
    Then the client shall return LP balances per corporation

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getLoyaltyPoints returns no results, the client shall return an empty array
    Given an authenticated character who has never run missions
    When the client calls getLoyaltyPoints for empty result
    Then the client shall return an empty loyalty points list

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getLoyaltyPoints returns multiple corps, the client shall identify the highest LP balance
    Given a character with LP across multiple corps
    When the client analyzes their LP balances
    Then the client shall identify the highest LP balance

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getLoyaltyStoreOffers is called, the client shall return available items with costs
    Given a valid NPC corporation
    When the client calls getLoyaltyStoreOffers
    Then the client shall return available items with costs

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN store offers are filtered by LP balance, the client shall return only affordable offers
    Given a set of store offers and a character LP balance
    When the client filters by what the character can afford
    Then the client shall return only the affordable offers

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getLoyaltyStoreOffers returns offers with required items, the client shall include item details
    Given store offers that require trade-in items
    When the client inspects the offers with requirements
    Then the client shall return the required items and quantities

  # EARS: Unwanted behavior
  Scenario: IF the token is missing, THEN the client shall throw a 403 forbidden EsiError for loyalty
    Given an unauthenticated loyalty request
    When the client calls getLoyaltyPoints without auth
    Then the client shall throw an EsiError with status 403 for loyalty

  # EARS: Unwanted behavior
  Scenario: IF ESI returns 500 internal server error, THEN the client shall throw a server-side EsiError
    Given the ESI service encounters an internal error
    When the client calls getLoyaltyStoreOffers expecting error
    Then the client shall throw an EsiError with status 500
"}
